newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian bank employees to go on strike on July 4.
newsitem.headline: Indian bank employees to go on strike on July 4.

text.p: Banking operations across India will be crippled by a strike on Friday by about 1.3 million employees over government plans to allow private banks to set operate in rural areas, trade union officials said on Thursday.

"About 1.3 million bank employees including over one million clerical staff and over 240,000 officers will strike work tomorrow," N. Nagarajan, general secretary of the Maharashtra State Committee of the All India Bank Officers' Association, told Reuters.
"We expect banking operations to be totally paralysed as all unions in the industry have come together," Nagarajan said.
He said the strike would have the support of employees from commercial banks, state-run banks, co-operative banks and rural banks.
The unions are protesting against government plans to allow the setting up of private banks in rural areas, which they say would affect existing state-run banks.
Other demands include revision of wages for employees in rural banks and the introduction of a pension scheme for employees in private banks.
